newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa may edge higher, eyes 1,060-1,070.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa may edge higher, eyes 1,060-1,070.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa futures could edge higher with September moving into the 1,060-1,070 area as the market continued its technical rebound from last week's sell-off, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
Traders called the market to open a couple of sterling- higher.
Adrian Haylor, an analyst at Sucden, said cocoa's rally over the past two days was seen as corrective after taking a severe pounding last week on a wave of fund-led selling.
September cocoa lost a steep 170 stg within two days last week to a low of 1,000 stg from a high of 1,170.
"It might take the market a little higher, might take it up to 1,060, possibly 1,070, that sort of area," Haylor said.
But he was uncertain if the market would make further headway from there. The next layer of resistance lies at the chart gap of between 1,087 and 1,108.
"That gap might not be filled," he said.
"But 1,000 is a good support," he said. "But I just think that the market would probably go a bit higher and the market will come back off again to retest the support."
In other news, the U.S. CFTC Commitment of Traders report released late on Monday showed positions held through July 1 and did not reflect the recent sharp sell-off on the New York cocoa futures.
